name: Michael Sagar Vasandani
headline: I chase interesting AI problems and ship what I find.
intro: I’m Michael Vasandani, a UC San Diego Data Science graduate and product builder working across the AI stack. I like taking ambitious ideas from prototype to reliable products people can use.
agenticNote: This is an agentic portfolio: Project Profiles and Recent Work are maintained from public GitHub evidence.
about: I’m interested in AI engineering and what it takes to ship new model capabilities as real-world products. I’m especially curious about evaluation, memory, and the systems that make AI reliable—and about how this technology could reshape the way we work, create, and live.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Data Science

hobbies: Outside of work, I enjoy building small experiments, learning in public, and following how new tools change the way people learn and collaborate.

experience.summary: Production agents, internal AI platforms, and developer workflows.
outcomes: Engineered a production multi-agent Crashlytics remediation workflow with GitHub Agentic Workflows for investigation, fix generation, and human-in-the-loop validation, cutting high-severity crash resolution from 3–4 days to about 1 day.

Built an internal AI copilot for 40+ product and engineering users to query ticket, PR, and feature context across internal systems using LangGraph, MCP tools, RAG-based memory, AWS CloudWatch, and DynamoDB.
Increased internal AI adoption by 70% by launching a reusable agent marketplace with CI/CD validation and versioning.
Automated documentation maintenance with an agentic workflow that detects drift and submits fixes, saving 10+ hours weekly.

experience.summary: LLM pipelines and Unreal Engine integration.
outcomes: Cut content authoring time by 85% with an LLM generation/compliance pipeline using FastAPI, MongoDB, and Ollama.
Integrated the system into Unreal Engine via C++ components, enabling real-time API calls and bulk dialogue importing.
Reduced LLM token usage and processing time by 70% using embedding-based retrieval over prior dialogue trees.
Built an AI knowledge base using Python, Codex, and Obsidian that transforms academic papers into knowledge graphs.
Accelerated an ETL pipeline 7× for 700M+ rows by optimizing BigQuery SQL and leveraging Polars for parallel processing.

experience.summary: Full-stack product delivery and web experiences.
outcomes: Increased website engagement by 45% by building Angular/TypeScript components and integrating REST services.
Owned full-stack features from requirements through production by collaborating across product and development teams.
Architected an internal GitHub analytics tool on AWS Lambda and DynamoDB, cutting leadership review time by 90%.
Engineered an LLM pipeline with RAG and Pinecone embeddings for natural-language codebase queries.
Configured a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with automated unit tests and security vulnerability scanning.
